text: A mushroom ambassador waits behind a low desk, its cap patched with court seals. It has no guards and no appetite for a fight; it wants to know whether the surface party will listen before the roots are disturbed.

views.text: The ambassador is a pale, jointed fungus in a damp office. Its copied ledgers are careful, useful records, and the room's only threat is the court's pressure outside.
The ambassador appears as a courteous little courtier in a velvet cap. Its tidy ledgers promise a harmless audience beneath the palace's music.
